questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many distinct real roots does the equation $x^4 - 66x^2 + 305 = 0$ possess?
questions.solution: Factoring $(x^2 - 61)(x^2 - 5) = 0$ with $61 \neq 5 > 0$ yields $4$ distinct real roots $\pm\sqrt{61}, \pm\sqrt{5}$.
questions.explanation: Apply discriminant & nature of roots techniques in Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming (Boolean Algebra Duality).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $x^2 - 63x + 62 = 0$ and $x^2 - 7x + k = 0$ share the common root $x = 1$, find the value of $k$.
questions.solution: Substituting the common root $x = 1$ into the second equation gives $1 - (7) + k = 0 \implies k = 6$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming (Tautology & Contrapositive Logic).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If the equations $2x^2 + 126x + 14 = 0$ and $x^2 + p x + q = 0$ have both roots in common, find the value of $p + q$.
questions.solution: Proportionality of coefficients $\frac{1}{2} = \frac{p}{126} = \frac{q}{14} \implies p = 63,\; q = 7 \implies p + q = 70$.
questions.explanation: Apply common roots & parameter elimination techniques in Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming (Corner Point Feasible Region).

questions.category: Location of Roots on Real Axis
questions.question: Find the largest integral value of $m$ for which the number $x = 8$ lies strictly between the two real roots of $f(x) = x^2 - 16x + m = 0$.
questions.solution: For $x = 8$ to lie strictly between the roots, $f(8) < 0 \implies 8^2 - 2(8^2) + m < 0 \implies m < 64$, so largest integer is $63$.
questions.explanation: Apply location of roots on real axis techniques in Mathematical Reasoning & Linear Programming (Negation of Quantified Statements).
